Comment.value:
This is a waypoint that can be placed in an area to mark a safe point where injured NPCs can rest. 

This will affect the animations and behavior of NPCs that spawn inside this area that are using the PlayAmbientAnimations functions (see the OnSpawn script nw_c2_default9 and the library x0_i0_anims for details). 

Note that this feature will only work in modules that use the XP1 modified AI.
